rows.proposal: I’m excited to help you build a robust experiment‑tracking and model‑registry pipeline. In another project I added full experiment tracking and a model registry for a telecom churn system, showcasing strong python engineering and gradient‑boosted trees. I can start by setting up MLflow for experiment logging and model versioning, then integrate a calibrated scikit‑learn chatbot model and add a validation step to flag uncertain responses.
